_comment: Yalla Fluent CAST REGISTRY v2 — the voice-identity library. Each character maps to an engine + voice identity + text mode + default performance. The synth pipeline reads this to route every script line to the right voice. LOCKED after the Phase B audition (GATE B). Three engines: VoiceTut (Egyptian-Arabic; Mahmoud + Macal), Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign (Nour + English guests), Qwen3-TTS VoiceClone (Ravi, from a CC0 Common Voice reference). Chatterbox is RETIRED (superseded by Qwen3-TTS).

voicetut.note: Egyptian-Arabic engine. Also renders ENGLISH text with a natural Egyptian accent (used for Macal). Shared Egyptian lexicon (egyptian_lexicon.json) applies to Arabic text. params: num_step=64, guidance_scale=2.5, speed=1.0. Requires companion 'omnivoice' (git+k2-fsa/OmniVoice) + transformers>=5.3.0; do NOT reinstall torch.

qwen3-tts-design.note: Apache-2.0. Natural-language voice design (instruct=description). Used to invent Nour + English guest voices. Load with attn_implementation='sdpa' (T4/Turing; NOT flash_attention_2).

qwen3-tts-clone.note: Apache-2.0. VoiceClone from a reference clip (create_voice_clone_prompt + generate_voice_clone). Used for Ravi (real Indian accent cloned from a CC0 Common Voice clip). Load with attn_implementation='sdpa'.

Coach.note: FIX-008 (diagnostic-driven, owner ear-confirmed): Mahmoud = 'Essam' at guidance_scale=1.5. Was 'Abdelrahman' @ gs2.5 which scored UTMOS ~3.03 (jittery/unstable pitch). A UTMOS audition of the VoiceTut male pool ranked Essam highest (~3.69 @ gs1.5); lowering guidance_scale from 2.5->1.5 calms the pitch jitter. Owner confirmed the Essam sample sounds human. (Earlier picks: Abdelrahman, Omar, placeholder Sayed — all free.)
Coach._pacing_note: FIX-007 (owner-approved by ear, option C): the ENGINE runs at natural speed (speed=1.0); pacing is a POST-PROCESSING step — post_processing.atempo=0.80 (pitch-preserving ffmpeg time-stretch) slows Mahmoud to a warm, deliberate teacher pace WITHOUT the choppiness the old text-injected prosody caused (FIX-001/005, removed). num_step/guidance_scale/speed are pure TTS engine params; atempo is applied after synthesis.

Macal.accent: egyptian-accented english (real, from the VoiceTut engine)
Macal.performance: earnest, hopeful; growth shown via LANGUAGE (fluency/contractions/confidence in the script), NOT an accent shift — accent stays Egyptian across all 3 stages
Macal.note: Owner B.6f: VoiceTut voice 'Abdullah' reads RAW English text with an Egyptian accent — no Latin->Arabic transliteration needed. Different voice from Sayed (Mahmoud).
Macal._pacing_note: FIX-007 (owner-approved by ear, option C): the ENGINE runs at natural speed (speed=1.0); pacing is a POST-PROCESSING step — post_processing.atempo=0.85 (pitch-preserving ffmpeg time-stretch) gives Macal a natural learner pace WITHOUT the choppiness of the old text-injected prosody (FIX-001, removed). num_step/guidance_scale/speed are pure TTS engine params; atempo is applied after synthesis.

Nour.voice_design: Adult female, 29, born and raised in Chicago USA. Warm, confident, clear General American accent - natural flap-T, full linking and reductions, relaxed native rhythm. Encouraging, friendly, articulate.
Nour._ref_note: canonical winning VoiceDesign take, frozen; production VoiceClones from this ref (Option B, no drift)
Nour.ref_text: Macal? You look like you just saw a ghost. What happened?

Tarek.voice_design: Adult male, 30, Egyptian from Cairo, highly fluent and polished English with only a faint accent. Fast, articulate, charismatic and a little slick. Warm surface, competitive underneath.
Tarek._ref_note: canonical winning VoiceDesign take, frozen; production VoiceClones from this ref (Option B, no drift)
Tarek.ref_text: Ah, of course you know the receptionist here too. Everyone loves Tarek.

Interviewer.voice_design: Adult female, 40, Emirati from the Gulf, professional English with a light Gulf-Arabic accent - measured, precise, slightly clipped. Dry, composed, quietly authoritative.
Interviewer._ref_note: canonical winning VoiceDesign take, frozen; production VoiceClones from this ref (Option B, no drift)
Interviewer.ref_text: Dune and Company. We need your answer by Friday. Are you still with us?

Barista.voice_design: Young female, 24, Filipina from Manila, friendly Filipino English accent - clear syllable-timed rhythm, crisp consonants, gently melodic intonation. Bright, upbeat, eager to please.
Barista._ref_note: canonical winning VoiceDesign take, frozen; production VoiceClones from this ref (Option B, no drift)
Barista.ref_text: Hello, sir. What can I get for you today?

Landlord.voice_design: Older male, 55, Pakistani, English with a Pakistani/Urdu accent - retroflex t/d, rolled r, deliberate measured delivery, formal older-generation phrasing. Steady, mature, a bit stern but not unkind.
Landlord._ref_note: canonical winning VoiceDesign take, frozen; production VoiceClones from this ref (Option B, no drift)
Landlord.ref_text: Macal, I'm not raising the rent because I want to. The building costs more now.

TaxiDriver.note: Owner B.6e: cloned from a real CC0 Common Voice Indian-accent clip via Qwen VoiceClone. CC0 = commercial-safe, no attribution required (attribution kept for provenance).
TaxiDriver._ref_note: ref is a raw CC0 Common Voice clip; transcript not saved -> clone via x_vector_only_mode

Friend_F._ref_note: canonical winning VoiceDesign take, frozen; production VoiceClones from this ref (Option B, no drift)

Official._ref_note: canonical winning VoiceDesign take, frozen; production VoiceClones from this ref (Option B, no drift)

Friend_M._ref_note: canonical winning VoiceDesign take, frozen; production VoiceClones from this ref (Option B, no drift)

arabic_voice_pool._comment: All 17 VoiceTut voices are usable. Full pool available for future Arabic casting. TAKEN: Essam=Mahmoud (Coach, FIX-008 — highest UTMOS in audition), Abdullah=Macal. ('Sayed', 'Omar', 'Abdelrahman' were earlier Coach picks, now free.)
